action_items: No backend test files were added this iteration: all 8 acceptance-matrix criteria are local-first/UI-state behaviors (localStorage invoices, pricing logic, calculator math, informational routes, mocked disclosures) with no FastAPI business-data endpoint backing them. The existing /api/status endpoints remain connectivity probes per spec_deviations and were not re-tested as they map to no criterion this round.

Authentication, payments, reminders, email, support, exports, and API access remain MOCKED/local demo interactions by approved plan; this was verified via visible disclosure text, not treated as a defect.

checks.criterion: Invoice counts remain consistent across navigation, overview, invoice list, and summary cards
checks.name: invoice-counts-consistent
checks.evidence: Sidebar badge and 'All invoices' card both read 4 on seeded state; creating a tscheck draft incremented both to 5 on /app and /app/invoices, and deleting it returned both to 4.

checks.criterion: Pricing recommendation thresholds agree with the visible plan capacities
checks.name: pricing-thresholds-match-capacities
checks.evidence: Capacity cards show 'Up to 5/50/200 invoices/month' and 'Unlimited'; slider at 5/50/200/201 recommended Free/Starter/Professional/Business respectively, matching the card text exactly.

checks.criterion: Overdue-interest calculation is transparent and avoids unsupported claims
checks.name: overdue-interest-estimate-disclaimer
checks.evidence: Edited principal, days, rate, source (tscheck-custom-rate-source), and effective date; formula/source/date reflected in assumptions block, output changed on rate edit, and page text read 'No rate is asserted as current, statutory, or applicable' and 'Estimate only — not legal, tax, or collection advice.'

checks.criterion: Footer links lead to real internal informational pages
checks.name: footer-informational-pages
checks.evidence: About, Security, Contact support, GST resources, Help center, API docs, Terms, and Privacy all rendered distinct information-heading/intro content; Contact form submission (tscheck-contact-name) showed 'Nothing was sent externally.'

checks.criterion: Landing and workspace sample figures cannot be mistaken for verified product results
checks.name: mocked-disclosures-labelled
checks.evidence: Homepage metrics-demo-label read 'Illustrative demo samples — not verified product results'; dashboard sample notice, invoices demo notice, invoice next-action feedback ('Nothing was sent externally'), and /security page text ('mocked for evaluation') all disclosed mocked/local behavior.

checks.criterion: Invoice collection workflow supports useful status distinctions and next actions
checks.name: invoice-workflow-filters-actions
checks.evidence: Search matched client name and status text ('overdue' -> 1 row); status filter options exactly ['All','Paid','Pending','Due soon','Overdue','Draft']; row showed due date/status/amount/next-action; triggering next action produced feedback containing 'Nothing was sent externally.'

checks.criterion: New invoice draft has clear requirements, validation, and live totals
checks.name: invoice-draft-validation-totals
checks.evidence: Missing description, zero amount, and due-date-before-invoice-date each surfaced invoice-validation-error; live total showed ₹11,800 at ₹10,000/18% then ₹23,600 at ₹20,000/18%; valid tscheck-draft-service draft saved locally with feedback 'No payment or reminder was created.'

checks.criterion: Key public, auth, dashboard, invoice, and form surfaces remain responsive
checks.name: responsive-no-overflow
checks.evidence: At 360/390/768/1024/1440 widths, document.scrollWidth<=clientWidth held on homepage; login, dashboard, invoice list, and new-draft form rendered without overflow at 360-1024, and the 360px mobile nav menu opened to reveal Pricing link.
